color.$description: Showrun MEDIA colour — v1.0.0, locked 2026-08-06. Showrun OS is a separate product with its own register; these do not apply to it. One accent; everything else neutral; all remaining colour comes from the photography. Every value was measured, and the ratio and reasoning are carried on the token so a future change can be checked rather than argued.

ground.$description: Exactly two. A mid-grey ground and a filled secondary panel were both tested and rejected — vermilion measures 1.16:1 on #808080, and any panel darker than paper drops the accent below AA-large. Secondary surfaces use a hairline-bordered card on paper.

paper.$description: Light ground. Warm-neutral, R−B spread +4, so it flatters tungsten in the photography.

charcoal.$description: Dark ground. Chosen against the photography: graded plates floor at ~26/255 luma because the Showrun grade lifts blacks. At luma 20.2 this sits BELOW that floor so images sit into the page. #1A1A1A matched the floor and edges dissolved; #1D1D1D sat above it and images punched a hole.

text.$description: Pure values, reserved for type. Never used as grounds.

grey.$description: Two, and two is the floor. No single value clears AA on both grounds — #6E6C69 is 4.76/3.52 and #808080 is 3.59/4.66. Dividers, hairlines and tints are alpha steps off the ground's grey, not separate tokens.

onPaper.$description: 4.76:1 on paper. Small text, labels, captions.

onCharcoal.$description: 6.54:1 on charcoal. Small text, labels, captions.

vermilion.$description: The only accent. Unrestricted on charcoal (5.42). On paper it is 3.09 — AA-large — so it is used there for navigational text only (section labels, FIG numbers, running heads), never to set body paragraphs and never as the sole carrier of unique information.

alpha.$description: Derived steps. Apply as opacity on the matching grey for the ground in use — never as new colour values.
